subject.title: fix #93908: [Bug]: [Bug]: Feishu plugin skipping discovery - host reports 2026.5.28 despite 2026.6.8 install

question: Should this PR be treated as the complete fix for the canonical plugin-skip issue, or only as the update-handoff fix while the unknown-host gateway startup variant remains tracked separately?
rationale: The code change is narrow and coherent, but automatic merge would close the linked issue even though a later live reproduction points at runtime host-version resolution rather than post-core update handoff.

options.title: Scope as update-handoff fix
options.body: Before merge, remove or qualify the automatic issue close and keep the unknown-host gateway startup variant tracked separately while accepting the installed-target compatibility contract for post-core updates.

options.title: Treat as complete fix
options.body: Merge with the current closing syntax if maintainers believe the later unknown-host report is a separate support/configuration problem rather than part of the canonical issue.

options.title: Pause for broader resolver fix
options.body: Hold this PR until the runtime host-version resolver path is fixed in the same branch or a merged companion PR.

recommendation.title: Scope as update-handoff fix
recommendation.body: Before merge, remove or qualify the automatic issue close and keep the unknown-host gateway startup variant tracked separately while accepting the installed-target compatibility contract for post-core updates.
